editorial:
Imagine working for a company that sells body fat scales, but almost every single employee is overweight. That is the funny and awkward situation you get into here. The big boss, Unosuke, realizes that his team looks like a bad advertisement for their own product, so he forces everyone to lose weight. Enter Nanako, a nutritionist with a plan to save the day. You will love how she takes over the company kitchen and turns boring diet food into something people actually want to eat. It is a lighthearted story about health and teamwork that feels like a warm hug.

The acting is great because the characters feel like real people you would meet at an office. The pace is steady, and while it is a simple plot, the food scenes make it feel special. One downside is that it is a bit predictable, but that just makes it a relaxing watch. If you are looking for a cozy movie night, you should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a smart move to keep those recipe vibes forever.
endingExplained: By the end, the employees finally reach their weight goals thanks to Nanako's tasty recipes and strict guidance. The big twist is that the weight loss does more than just make them look better; it boosts their confidence and improves the company's sales. The movie wraps up with the team celebrating their health journey together, proving that eating right does not have to be miserable when you have a great teacher.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cozy stories about self-improvement and delicious food.
